artifacts.body: Family: flat 2D vector. Shape language: rounded single-volume body, no limbs. Line: 2px uniform warm-black outline. Shading: two-step cel shadow, no gradient. Palette: leaf green, terracotta pot, ash shadow. Forbidden drift: no added limbs, no photoreal shading.

S1 0-5s orient: Milo on the windowsill, sun camera-left. S2 5-11s problem: leaf edge curling. S3 11-18s arrival: SHADOW drifts in from frame-right. S4 18-25s relief: leaf flattens under shade. S5 25-32s risk: sun tracks, shade slips. S6 32-38s decision: Milo tips the pot. S7 38-41s action: pot rolls behind the wall. S8 41-45s payoff: wide, pot behind wall, leaves intact.
No spoken dialogue. Narration is off-camera and reserved for post; timing is carried by the cue sheet.

Use MILO v01 and SHADOW v01 as on-model sources. Preserve silhouette, proportions, outline, and palette. Staging: Milo frame-left, shadow entering frame-right. Action: one drift. Camera: locked. Timing: held. Audio: room tone only.
V1 main picture S1-S8. V2 shade overlay. A1 room tone. A2 score bed, ducked under no speech. Captions: not required, no dialogue. Export: verified destination settings.
